original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

scope_change_reason: Profiling rejects whole-circuit tableau reuse (zero repeated circuits); optimize the measured dense literal pure P/D address/phase setup instead, retaining the second interpreter and all amplitude comparisons.
bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
stop_rule: Stop without retry on source/coverage/receipt/mode drift, unexpected stderr or resource failure. One serial profile plus first pair: 900 seconds aggregate, 600 seconds per command, 1 GiB sampled group RSS; require >=15% wall and CPU saving before expanding to separately gated qualification under 1500 seconds cumulative.
evidence: PROFILE.json, BENCHMARK.json, PROOF.md, VALIDATION.json and evidence/ retain source-bound profiling, complete stdout equivalence, finite controls and guarded full runs; exact-head hosted CI is separate.
author: Chris R / Clear1nsight
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for source review, execution, tooling and report; no subagents, independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

open_questions.question: Does this exact source-bound speedup hold on a second host?
open_questions.why_it_matters: One baseline observation and shared host load limit the performance conclusion.
open_questions.first_step: Repeat the bounded pair in a fresh work directory, retaining every sample and complete outputs.
open_questions.blocked_by: Separate authorized measurement; no new source or kappa transfer.

open_questions.question: Can this setup reuse be transferred to a changed literal compiler?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The method and AST sites are pinned to one original implementation.
open_questions.first_step: Authenticate the changed source and prove every substituted scalar lookup before any full run.
open_questions.blocked_by: New coverage, overlap and feasibility gates; no automatic successor admission.
